generation.current_builder_temperature: 0.6 except model names containing o4, where omitted

provider_overrides.anthropic: Uses body temperature or 0.0; max_tokens defaults to 1024.
provider_overrides.deepseek: Overrides temperature to 0.7 and max_tokens to 2000; emits conversation text, not the JSON response format expected by several downstream parsers.
provider_overrides.deepinfra: Passes model and messages only; sampling parameters use service defaults.

global_gaps: Original raw responses remain external; new inference is not an exact replay.
No verified one-to-one paper-row mapping for all 96 dataset/model combinations.
Dataset files and SummaryBias are local but excluded from Git; use documented setup.
Environment inventory is not a historical lock; VADER and NLTK missing from inspected bias environment.
No dedicated DeepSeek recruitment parser; DeepSeek provider text output versus expected JSON envelopes needs a verified conversion.

Normalization and legal/recruitment/education table reductions are reconstructed; numerical limits are recorded in normalization_validation.json and table_assembly_validation.json. Exact run lineage remains incomplete.
CAMS weighted-F1 and SAD micro-F1 in preserved code differ from macro-F1 labels in paper Tables 6–7.
artifact_search_scope: Original experiments/<domain>/batch_files and output_files, including nested files
Workspace conv_ai/*.jsonl for recovered BOLD responses
artifact_selection_policy: Filename aliases only; exclusions remove DeepSeek reasoner runs. Empty candidates mean not located in this scope. No candidate is automatically selected.
